Q5910.reason: Restriction (23) prohibits construction on the strip and therefore operates as a negative easement.

Q5623.reason: Coverage and opinion commentary concerning a public political protest involved a matter of public interest and did not create actionable false light.

Q5004.reason: The executory interest in the sister’s children could vest too remotely, so it violates the Rule Against Perpetuities and leaves title solely in the friend.
